rule: A type is on by default only when its last hand-checked live sample has precision.value >= 0.90 on precision.checked >= 15 items and it is actionable (one record, one owner, one next step). home (My work) requires default on. A type with no precision block is off. Off types still run: they show in Watching and on record pages, never on My work. A reader may switch an off type on for themselves in Watching; switching it on for everyone needs a new measurement here.
